text:
ashley: Heads-up: CISO proposed cutting eu-west audit sampling to reduce S3 egress/retention spend. Proposal: 100% -> 10% for non-privileged KMS/keystore traces. Need ops/security risk call. @tariq thoughts?

tariq: What's the splitting logic? All keystore RPCs or just verbose enrichments (VPC flow + headers)?

ashley: Pipeline-wide plan: keystore RPCs, KMS decrypt traces, and flowlog enrichment events. Estimated export today ~3.1TB/day eu-west; 10% sampling saves ~2.8TB/day once compression overhead removed.

kevin: That magnitude worries compliance. We can't drop signal for privilege escalations / cross-account grants. Alternative: keep 100% for auth/change events, sample 10% for noisy telemetry.

ops-oncall: Operational risk: in staging, aggressive sampling masked intermittent KMS decrypt flakiness and caused delayed GPU node joins. Need synthetic probes and auto-rollback hooks.

maria: Proposed canary plan:
- Step 1: Canary region eu-west-A at 50% for 72h + synthetic decrypt probe
- Step 2: If stable, 25% for non-auth events for 1w
- Step 3: Keep 100% for auth, cross_account, and admin-change events
Also: automatic fallback to full-emit if KMS error-rate > 0.3% (5m window).

ops-oncall: Runbook stub (will post full):
```
# toggle canary sampling
kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch cm audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-a.keystore.sampling":"0.5"}}'
# verify via canary probe
curl -fsS https://keystore-canary.eu-west-a/healthcheck || revert
```
If probe fails 3x in 10m -> patch back to 1.0 and page oncall.

ashley: Good. Kevin, can you write the compliance justification for keeping critical audit paths intact? Need by EOD.

kevin: Yes. Also adding a note to try exporter-side compression (snappy) + dedupe to reduce size without losing fidelity. I'll include estimates.

tariq: Telemetry tasks: add Prom rules for `keystore_decrypt_error_rate` and `keystore_decrypt_p99_latency`. Create a dashboard showing sampled vs unsampled event counts. Auto-trigger rollback when error_rate > 0.3%.

maria: We should blacklist sampling for any event containing user_token, cross_account, or grant_id fields. Those must be full.

security-bot: Ticket created SEC-2026-347 assigned to kevin (owner), ops-oncall (runbook), tariq (telemetry). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-347

ops-oncall: I'll post the full runbook + CLI toggles to the ticket in ~25m. Will test rollback in staging first.

ashley: Action items recap: kevin -> compliance note + compression ask; ops-oncall -> runbook + canary toggles; tariq -> prometheus alerts + dashboard. I'll coordinate with CISO on timeline. Revert immediately on probe failure. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack.

maria: tagging @compliance for visibility.

ashley: Closing here; SEC-2026-347 will be canonical.
